name: Sleepers' Key
summary: At Stonetalon Peak, Sleepers' Key helps protect a sacred druidic vault. Night elf druids made it one of three enchanted keys for the Talon Den Hoard.

sections.title: A Druidic Safeguard
sections.body:
The Talon Den is a redoubt and sanctum for the druids of Kalimdor on Stonetalon Peak. Night elf keepers built locks and hidden caches to guard sacred relics and potent treasures from unwanted attention. Sleepers' Key is one of three keys that form a protective ward.

Sleepers' Key rests in a secluded cache deep in the den. The Gatekeeper's Key, hidden near the threshold, opens that cache. The Claw Key and the Barrow Key complete the set. Set all three keys into the Talon Den Hoard's stone locks, and the ward fades. Ancient items lie within.

faq.q: What is the Sleepers' Key used for?
faq.answer: Sleepers' Key opens the Talon Den Hoard with the Barrow Key and Claw Key. The warded stone vault lies deep within the barrow den at Stonetalon Peak.

faq.q: How was the Sleepers' Key locked away?
faq.answer: The druids placed Sleepers' Key in the Sleepers' Cache in the Talon Den's northwestern tunnels. The Gatekeeper's Key opens it. The druids hid that key in an unassuming lantern near the den's entrance.

faq.q: Why did the druids hide their relics with multiple keys?
faq.answer: The night elf druids built complex safeguards to keep their powerful items and sacred heirlooms from enemy hands if the den came under attack. By hiding the keys in separate caches, they made the hoard difficult for intruders to plunder.

faq.q: Why is it called the Sleepers' Key?
faq.answer: The druids never explain the name. Sleepers' Key shares it with the Sleepers' Cache, the hidden chest in the Talon Den where the key is kept.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see how the Talon Den's keys and caches layer defenses. Hidden caches and keyed locks seal away relics of power.

As a member of the Horde, acquiring Sleepers' Key is part of an orchestrated raid into the heart of Stonetalon Peak. The raid strips away the night elves' defensive wards to claim the relics sealed in their hoard.
